decision_candidates:
CREATE TABLE decision_candidates (
        study_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES studies(study_id), candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0), previous INTEGER,
        origin_key TEXT NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(body)<=65536),
        task_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(study_id,candidate_id,version),
        CHECK((version=1 AND previous IS NULL) OR (version>1 AND previous IS NOT NULL AND previous=version-1)),
        FOREIGN KEY(study_id,candidate_id,previous)
            REFERENCES decision_candidates(study_id,candidate_id,version),
        FOREIGN KEY(study_id,task_id) REFERENCES tasks(study_id,task_id))

decision_dispatches:
CREATE TABLE decision_dispatches (
        dispatch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        study_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES studies(study_id), decision_id TEXT,
        publication_id TEXT, assessment_id TEXT, task_id TEXT, run_id TEXT UNIQUE,
        result BLOB NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        CHECK((task_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL) OR
              (task_id IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND assessment_id IS NOT NULL
               AND decision_id IS NOT NULL AND publication_id IS NOT NULL)),
        FOREIGN KEY(study_id,decision_id) REFERENCES research_decisions(study_id,decision_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(study_id,publication_id) REFERENCES decision_publications(study_id,publication_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(study_id,assessment_id) REFERENCES decision_assessments(study_id,assessment_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(study_id,task_id,run_id) REFERENCES runs(study_id,task_id,run_id))

        provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL,

evidence_requires_success:
CREATE TRIGGER evidence_requires_success BEFORE INSERT ON evidence
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE run_id = NEW.run_id
            AND status = 'succeeded' AND result_json = NEW.result_json)
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'evidence requires matching successful run'); END
finalized_run_immutable:
CREATE TRIGGER finalized_run_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON runs
        WHEN OLD.status <> 'running'
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'completed run is immutable'); END

        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('valid','invalid','review_required')),
        proposal_id TEXT REFERENCES plan_proposals(proposal_id),

        raw_sha256 TEXT,

        CHECK((status='valid' AND proposal_id IS NOT NULL AND raw IS NOT NULL

           OR (status<>'valid' AND proposal_id IS NULL AND diagnostic IS NOT NULL))

runs:
CREATE TABLE runs (
        run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        study_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        ended_at TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('running','succeeded','failed','interrupted')),
        exit_code INTEGER,
        error TEXT,
        stdout TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        stderr TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        result_json TEXT,
        wall_seconds REAL CHECK(wall_seconds >= 0),
        llm_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(llm_tokens = 0),
        gpu_seconds REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(gpu_seconds = 0),
        human_minutes REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(human_minutes = 0),
        cpu_seconds REAL,
        FOREIGN KEY(study_id, task_id) REFERENCES tasks(study_id, task_id),
        UNIQUE(study_id, task_id, run_id),
        CHECK((status = 'running' AND ended_at IS NULL AND result_json IS NULL)
           OR (status = 'succeeded' AND ended_at IS NOT NULL AND result_json IS NOT NULL
               AND exit_code = 0 AND error IS NULL AND wall_seconds IS NOT NULL)
           OR (status IN ('failed','interrupted') AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
               AND result_json IS NULL AND error IS NOT NULL))
    )
runs_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER runs_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON runs BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'runs history cannot be deleted'); END
studies:
CREATE TABLE studies (
        study_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        singleton INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(singleton = 1),
        question TEXT NOT NULL,
        success_criteria_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        constraints_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        source BLOB NOT NULL,
        source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,

task_proposal_immutable:
CREATE TRIGGER task_proposal_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF
        study_id, task_id, title, description, kind, input_json, created_at, sequence ON tasks
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'task proposal is immutable'); END
task_transition:
CREATE TRIGGER task_transition BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON tasks
        WHEN NOT ((OLD.status = 'pending' AND NEW.status = 'running')
            OR (OLD.status = 'running' AND NEW.status IN ('succeeded','failed','needs_review'))
            OR (OLD.status IN ('failed','needs_review') AND NEW.status = 'pending'))
        BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid task transition'); END
tasks:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        study_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES studies(study_id),
        task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        description TEXT NOT NULL,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind = 'demo_mean'),
        input_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','running','succeeded','failed','needs_review')),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(study_id, task_id)
    )
tasks_no_delete: CREATE TRIGGER tasks_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON tasks BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tasks history cannot be deleted'); END
